capabilities: Provide nine commands that open the first nine bookmarks
Assign custom hotkeys to each bookmark command via Obsidian settings
Open one of the first nine bookmarks in a new pane
extras: Depends on the built-in Bookmarks core plugin being enabled; it only reacts to whatever the user has bookmarked first. The README still shows install instructions referencing its old 'Shortcuts for starred files' name. Development is supported via Ko-fi.
intentEvidence: You have to bookmark files and searches with the core Bookmark plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in per-item hotkeys for bookmarks, so jumping to a specific bookmarked file requires navigating menus instead of the keyboard.

relations.evidence: You have to bookmark files and searches with the core Bookmark plugin.

summary: Adds nine commands that open the first nine bookmarks, assignable to custom hotkeys, plus a command to open a bookmark in a new pane.
